items.title: Logitech confirms data breach after Clop extortion attack
items.description: Hardware accessory giant Logitech has confirmed it suffered a data breach in a cyberattack claimed by the Clop extortion gang, which conducted Oracle E-Business Suite data theft attacks in July. [...]

items.title: Akira RaaS Targets Nutanix VMs, Threatens Critical Orgs
items.description: The Akira ransomware group has been experimenting with new tools, bugs, and attack surfaces, with demonstrated success in significant sectors.

items.title: New Security Tools Target Growing macOS Threats
items.description: A public dataset and platform-agnostic analysis tool aim to help organizations in the fight against Apple-targeted malware, which researchers say has lacked proper attention.

items.title: Five plead guilty to helping North Koreans infiltrate US firms
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice announced that five individuals pleaded guilty to aiding North Korea's illicit revenue generation schemes, including remote IT worker fraud and cryptocurrency theft. [...]

items.title: Learning Sales Skills Can Make Security Professionals More Effective
items.description: Amazon Web Services VP Sara Duffer highlights the top lessons she brought back to her security role after taking part in Amazon's shadow program.
